messages.subject: ADREPORT after model optimized
parts:
I work with analyses where there are a large possible number of values that you might want to ADREPORT from a fitted model. The values to be reported are passed as indices in the data.  I tried the following and it appears to work but want to make sure I'm not overlooking something that I don't fully understand in the inner workings of TMB.

1) from a model fitted previously with TMB extract the parameter estimates
2) create f with MakeADFun using those parameter estimates and specifying the indices for the values to be ADREPORTed.
3) call sdreport with f to extract the ADREPORTed values


When I did this the ADREPORTed values and std errors matched what I got when I fit the model, so presumably the above procedure works.  This is quite useful for me to get any values I may want after fitting the model without the cost of reporting all possible values when the model is fitted. It also provides the option to get the v-c matrix for the subset of values rather than all possible values which could be very large.

regards --jeff
